fields.title: The Key Teachings
fields.description: Short, faithful guides by Ochorus to the heart of one classic author's teaching — each chapter ending in questions and a prayer, and pointing the reader on to the author's own books.

fields.title: Brave for God
fields.description: True stories of faith for young readers: ordinary people from every part of the world who trusted God and were made brave.

fields.title: Rooted – 30 Days with God for Youth
fields.description: Thirty-day devotionals for readers aged 9 to 12, one book at a time: a verse, what it means, a question to think about, something to try, and a prayer.

fields.title: Daughters of the King – 30 Days with God for Girls
fields.description: Thirty-day devotionals for girls aged 9 to 12: who you are as a daughter of the King, and the brave women of the Bible and of history who trusted Him.

fields.title: Sons of the King – 30 Days with God for Guys
fields.description: Thirty-day devotionals for boys aged 9 to 12: who you are as a son of the King, strength under control, and the brave men of the Bible and of history who trusted Him.

fields.title: Portraits of Courage
fields.description: Full-length Christian biographies of men and women who counted the cost and followed Christ anyway — each life told alongside its teaching, weighed under Scripture, and written with gratitude but not hagiography.

fields.title: Straight Talk
fields.description: Christian classics and true lives retold for teenage readers, honest and in plain words: Bunyan's pilgrim on the road to the Celestial City, Spurgeon's straight talk from the farm, and the men and women who staked everything on God.

fields.title: The Holy Spirit, or Power from on High
fields.description: A. B. Simpson's two-volume study of the Holy Spirit through the whole Bible: the Old Testament's types, emblems and prophecies in Part I, and the New Testament from the Gospels to Revelation in Part II.

fields.title: Anchored – 30 Days with God for Teens
fields.description: Thirty-day devotionals for readers aged 13 to 17 that take the hard questions seriously: a Bible passage, an honest teaching, a question, something to try, a prayer, and a classic to go deeper.

fields.title: They Were Young
fields.description: True stories for readers aged 13 to 17 of people whose faith began, or was tested, before they were grown — told in full, in their own words where we have them, with questions to think through.

fields.title: Real Questions
fields.description: Honest, short answers for readers aged 13 to 17 to the questions teenagers actually ask about God, the Bible, Jesus, and life — clear where Christians agree, fair where they differ, and pointing on to the classics.

fields.title: شجعان من أجل الله
fields.description: قصص حقيقية عن الإيمان للقرّاء الصغار: أناس عاديون من كل أنحاء العالم وثقوا بالله فصاروا شجعانًا.

fields.title: Abavumu ku lwa Katonda
fields.description: Emboozi ez’amazima ez’okukkiriza eri abasomi abato: abantu ba bulijjo okuva mu buli kitundu ky’ensi abeesiga Katonda, n’abafuula abavumu.

fields.title: Відважні для Бога
fields.description: Правдиві історії віри для юних читачів: звичайні люди з усіх куточків світу, які довіряли Богові й стали відважними.

fields.title: परमेश्वर के लिये साहसी
fields.description: युवा पाठकों के लिये विश्वास की सच्ची कहानियाँ: संसार के हर कोने के साधारण लोग जिन्होंने परमेश्वर पर भरोसा रखा और साहसी बनाए गए।

fields.title: जड़ें जमाए — युवाओं के लिये परमेश्वर के साथ 30 दिन
fields.description: 9 से 12 वर्ष के पाठकों के लिये तीस-दिवसीय भक्ति-वार्ताएँ, एक बार में एक पुस्तक: एक वचन, उसका अर्थ, सोचने के लिये एक प्रश्न, करने के लिये एक बात, और एक प्रार्थना।

fields.title: متأصّلون – 30 يومًا مع الله للناشئين
fields.description: تأمّلات يومية على مدى ثلاثين يومًا للقرّاء من سنّ التاسعة إلى الثانية عشرة، كتابًا بعد كتاب: آية، وما تعنيه، وسؤال للتفكير، وأمر للتجربة، وصلاة.

fields.title: صور من الشجاعة
fields.description: سير مسيحية كاملة لرجال ونساء حسبوا النفقة وتبعوا المسيح مع ذلك: كل حياة تُروى مع تعليمها، وتوزن في ضوء الكتاب المقدس، وتُكتب بامتنان لا بتمجيد.

fields.title: Retratos de coraje
fields.description: Biografías cristianas completas de hombres y mujeres que calcularon el costo y aun así siguieron a Cristo: cada vida contada junto con su enseñanza, sopesada a la luz de las Escrituras y escrita con gratitud, pero sin hagiografía.

fields.title: साहस के चित्र
fields.description: उन पुरुषों और स्त्रियों की पूर्ण मसीही जीवनियाँ जिन्होंने कीमत का हिसाब लगाया और फिर भी मसीह के पीछे चले — हर जीवन उसकी शिक्षा के साथ कहा गया, पवित्रशास्त्र की कसौटी पर परखा गया, और कृतज्ञता से लिखा गया, पर बिना अतिशय महिमामंडन के।

fields.title: Retratos de Coragem
fields.description: Biografias cristãs completas de homens e mulheres que calcularam o custo e, mesmo assim, seguiram a Cristo — cada vida narrada ao lado do seu ensino, pesada à luz das Escrituras e escrita com gratidão, mas sem hagiografia.

fields.title: Taswira za Ujasiri
fields.description: Wasifu kamili wa Kikristo wa wanaume na wanawake waliohesabu gharama na bado wakamfuata Kristo — kila maisha yakisimuliwa pamoja na mafundisho yake, yakipimwa kwa Maandiko, na kuandikwa kwa shukrani bila kuwatukuza kupita kiasi.

fields.title: Портрети мужності
fields.description: Повні християнські біографії чоловіків і жінок, які порахували ціну й усе ж пішли за Христом, — кожне життя розказане разом із його вченням, зважене у світлі Святого Письма й написане з вдячністю, але без агіографії.

fields.title: Valientes por Dios
fields.description: Historias verdaderas de fe para lectores jóvenes: gente común de todas partes del mundo que confió en Dios y fue hecha valiente.

fields.title: Courageux pour Dieu
fields.description: Des histoires vraies de foi pour les jeunes lecteurs : des gens ordinaires, venus de tous les coins du monde, qui se confièrent en Dieu et furent rendus courageux.

fields.title: Corajosos por Deus
fields.description: Histórias verdadeiras de fé para leitores jovens: gente comum de todas as partes do mundo que confiou em Deus e foi feita corajosa.

fields.title: ሥር የሰደደ – ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር 30 ቀናት ለወጣቶች
የንጉሡ ሴት ልጆች – ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር 30 ቀናት ለልጃገረዶች
Enracinés – 30 jours avec Dieu pour les jeunes
fields.description: Des méditations sur trente jours pour les lecteurs de 9 à 12 ans, un livre à la fois: un verset, ce qu’il veut dire, une question pour réfléchir, une chose à faire et une prière.

fields.title: Wenye Mizizi – Siku 30 na Mungu kwa Vijana
fields.description: Tafakari za siku thelathini kwa wasomaji wenye umri wa miaka 9 hadi 12, kitabu kimoja baada ya kingine: mstari wa Biblia, maana yake, swali la kufikiria, jambo la kujaribu, na sala.

fields.title: Franc-parler
fields.description: Des classiques chrétiens et des vies vraies racontés pour les adolescents, avec franchise et en mots simples : le pèlerin de Bunyan sur la route de la Cité céleste, le franc-parler de Spurgeon depuis la ferme, et les hommes et les femmes qui ont tout misé sur Dieu.
